messages:
Ravi: Heads up — finance asked for a concrete proposal on spot buffer sizing to reduce month-to-month chargeback variance. Can we get numbers + operational impacts?

Mina (FinOps): copy. need 3 scenarios: conservative, target, aggressive. show unit economics vs on-demand and with 7/14 day smoothing.

Alex: +1. we also need preemption tail-risk calc per region. us-west current interruption rate ~6% last 30d.

Lisa: I can run a quick sim. what's the target SLA for Dedicated customers?

Ravi: SLA target same as before — p50 latency and 99.9% availability on reserved. Buffer should not impact latency SLO.

Alex: quick paste of sim output:
```
scenario,spot%,buffer_gpus,expected_cost_savings,variance_reduction
conservative,60,80,22%,30%
target,75,120,33%,55%
aggressive,90,160,42%,70%
```

Mina (FinOps): these savings vs on-demand look plausible. Need adjustment for regional price spikes and interruption tax.

Alex: interruption tax calc = preemptions * avg_runtime_loss * gpu_unit_cost. also add failover infra cost. rough numbers attached in the gsheet.

Ryan: also flag: network egress when jobs migrate across regions — we saw ~15% extra egress last month for cross-region rehoming. factor that into worst-case.

finops-bot: Monthly variance report uploaded — https://redwood.internal/finops/reports/2026-12-spot-variance :file_folder: (auto-generated)

Mina (FinOps): propose chargeback smoothing: 30% of spot variance expense moved to infra reserve; remaining charged monthly with a 3-month rolling average smoothing window. I'll push to finance for approval.

Ravi: can we quantify reserve size? Alex/Lisa?

Lisa: based on the target scenario sim, reserve = 0.2 * monthly spot spend ≈ $120k. covers ~2-sigma monthly spikes in current volatility. includes a cushion for regional price spikes.

Mina (FinOps): i'll draft PO language and the chargeback rules. also recommend tagging jobs with pool_id and cost_center for attribution in the console.

Alex: ops note — mixed-capacity autoscaler change: fallback path prefers local-region on-demand first, then cross-region spot, then on-demand cross-region. reduces egress churn. will put impact doc in eng docs.

Ryan: can we add a Console metric: "reserve drawdown vs replenishment" and an alert when reserve < 30%? filed RD-402 for tracking.

Ravi: next steps: Mina to send proposal to finance by EOD Wed; Lisa to validate sim against 30-day eviction traces; Alex to produce autoscaler impact doc and list of pools expected to change.

Mina (FinOps): ok — ping me if you have updates. :thumbsup:

Alex: temporary note: we should run a 2-week canary with the target scenario in us-east-1 only before any broad change. low-risk traffic tags only.

Lisa: agreed. will schedule canary and share runbook.

Ravi: thanks all, this is actionable.
